_readme: On-foot street stage 'street1' (parts/foot.js, flag RET.foot). Lyrics = None. Until these exist the stage plays the 'stage2' song. Enemy shots release on the half beat, so keep a steady kick from bar 1.

street1.prompt: Instrumental cyberpunk run-and-gun game soundtrack, no vocals, no spoken words, 4/4, strong kick on every beat from the first bar, 128 BPM, gritty street synth bass, metallic percussion, distorted stabs, tense but fun, rain and neon underpass mood, 4-bar intro then 16-bar sections, ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

street1-lock.prompt: Same track family as street1, 128 BPM, arena-lock variation: louder drums, rising siren synth, 8-bar loop, no vocals, steady kick every beat, ends on a whole bar.

street1-boss.prompt: Instrumental cyberpunk boss fight, no vocals, 140 BPM, heavy industrial drums, kick on every beat from bar 1, menacing bass, alarm synth hook, 16-bar loop that ends on a whole bar, mixed for a phone game.

street1-clear.prompt: Short instrumental victory sting, cyberpunk synth, 128 BPM, 2 bars, bright major chord at the end, no vocals.
